description: The bar chart illustrates a comparison of “Average Performance” between two methods — “Standard” (gray) and “Ours” (blue) — across three categories: an unlabeled baseline (first bar), CORG, and AdaCAD. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Average Performance,” ranges from 48 to 62 with tick marks at intervals of 2. The horizontal x-axis lists the three categories. In the first category (unlabeled), only the “Ours” method is shown, with a performance value of approximately 59.5. For CORG, the “Standard” method achieves a performance of about 51.5, while “Ours” reaches approximately 59.5, resulting in a stacked bar where the blue portion sits atop the gray. For AdaCAD, “Standard” achieves roughly 53.5, and “Ours” adds approximately 7.0 to reach a total of about 60.5, again shown as a stacked bar. The legend in the top-left corner identifies gray as “Standard” and blue as “Ours.” The chart visually emphasizes that “Ours” consistently outperforms “Standard” in both CORG and AdaCAD, and achieves high performance even in the unlabeled case where no “Standard” baseline is provided.
